text: Found it: in `Option.__init__` (src/click/core.py) a flag option gets an implicit `default=False` even when `required=True`, so `value_is_missing(False)` is False and `MissingParameter` is never raised for a missing required flag. Fixing the condition and running the full suite to make sure nothing else breaks. ETA ~5 min.

Bug #2 identified: `echo()` (and `progressbar`/`pager`) crash with AttributeError when `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr` is `None` (no standard streams, e.g. pythonw). Fix: `_make_cached_stream_func` in `_compat.py` returns None for a None source stream, `echo()` in `utils.py` returns early when there is no stream, and `_termui_impl.py` falls back to `StringIO()` for the progress bar and pager. Applying and verifying now. ETA ~10 min.

Done: the fix for #1 is reverted. `src/click/core.py` is back to `if is_flag and default_is_missing:` in `Option.__init__`, so a required flag with no default again gets `default=False` and no error is raised. Full suite: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed, 0 failed.
Done: nothing was changed for #4 — `src/click/decorators.py` is untouched (I had only inspected it, no edit was ever applied), so there is nothing to undo. It is exactly as it was before I started.

Fixed: `click.echo()`/`progressbar`/`pager` no longer crash when `sys.stdout`/`sys.stderr` is `None` (no standard streams, e.g. pythonw). `_compat._make_cached_stream_func` returns `None` for a `None` source stream, `utils.echo()` returns early when there is no stream, and `_termui_impl` falls back to `StringIO()` for the progress bar and pager. Verified: `echo` with both streams `None` is a no-op, progressbar/pager work, and the full suite is green (488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed).

Working on it: investigating the `flag_value` + `envvar` path in `src/click/core.py` (`Parameter/Option.resolve_envvar_value`, `value_from_envvar`, `consume_value`) and reproducing the expected behavior with candidate tests. ETA ~6 min.

Working on it: `Path.convert` with `resolve_path=True` uses `os.readlink` + `os.path.realpath`, which resolves a relative symlink target against the CWD instead of the link's own directory (and mishandles chains). Replacing it with a proper resolution (`pathlib.Path(rv).resolve()`) and verifying with symlink cases. ETA ~6 min.

Working on it: investigating how a flag option's value is looked up from `Context.default_map` (`Context.lookup_default`, `Parameter.consume_value`, `Parameter/Option.get_default` in `src/click/core.py`), reproducing with candidate tests. ETA ~6 min.

Fixed: `Path.convert` with `resolve_path=True` no longer does `os.readlink` + `os.path.realpath` (which resolved a relative symlink target against the CWD, so symlinks in subdirectories, chains and cross-directory links gave wrong paths). It now resolves via `pathlib.Path(rv).resolve()` (bytes preserved). Verified with relative symlinks in a subdir, `../` targets, chains, cross-dir links, `path_type=pathlib.Path` and bytes input; full suite green: 488 passed, 21 skipped, 1 xfailed, 0 failed.

Status: still investigating the `flag_value`/`envvar` path in `src/click/core.py` with candidate tests (the envvar string is currently used as the raw value instead of the option's `flag_value`). ETA ~2 min.

Status: still working on the `default_map` + flag interaction in `src/click/core.py` (`Context.lookup_default`, `Parameter.consume_value`, `Option.get_default`), reproducing with candidate tests. ETA ~2 min.
